request.description: The Regal debugger only supports launch requests.

bundlePaths.description: List of paths to load as bundles for policy and data. Defaults to the worktree root unless dataPaths is set. Set to [] to disable loading of bundles.

dataPaths.description: List of paths to load policy and data files from.

input.description: Input document, provided inline as a JSON value. Takes precedence over inputPath.

inputPath.description: Path to an input document (JSON or YAML).

trace.description: Enable logging of the Debug Adapter Protocol.

logLevel.description: Log level for messages printed to the debug console. If not set, no log messages are printed.
